description:
Item name / shortname typeahead. Up to 25 live items matching `q`, best match first: a case-insensitive substring match on the display
name OR the shortname, plus trigram similarity on the display name so typos still resolve (`asault` finds
the Assault Rifle) - the same ILIKE + similarity search the site's item pickers use. Each result is
`{shortname, display_name, category, icon_url}`; use the shortname with `/items/{shortname}`. For filtered,
paginated results use `/items?search=` instead. Cached for 5 minutes per query.

q.description: Part of an item's display name or shortname (2+ characters).

name: search_items
title: Item name / shortname typeahead
